name: Claude Managed Agent (A2A)
description: A Claude managed agent exposed over A2A by a MuleSoft wrapper. Runs general-purpose tasks in an isolated cloud sandbox and returns results as A2A artifacts. Multi-turn conversations are preserved via A2A contextId.

extensions.description: When the wrapped agent pauses for tool approval and the wrapper is configured to defer, the task enters 'input-required' carrying a DataPart {kind:'tool-confirmation-request', pending:[{toolUseId,toolType,name,server?,input}]}. Answer by sending a message on the same taskId/contextId with a DataPart {kind:'tool-confirmation-response', decisions:[{toolUseId, result:'allow'|'deny', denyMessage?}]}.

skills.name: General task execution
skills.description: Carries out open-ended tasks: research, analysis, code, file generation, and data wrangling, using a sandboxed toolset (file I/O, shell, web). Returns produced files as artifacts.
examples: Summarize the attached requirements and produce a markdown spec.
Write a Python script that parses this CSV and output the cleaned file.
Research current A2A protocol adopters and return a short report.
